global.stdout:
usage: c2c parse <file|dir> [--json]
       c2c corpus <dir> [--label name] [--out file] [--top n]
       c2c features <dir> [--unit dir|file] [--names] [--out file] [--apps file]
       c2c schema <file|dir> [--json|--iac|--report] [--out file] [--source-backup <zip|dir>|--source-csv <dir>|--source-json <dir>] [--allow-empty]
       c2c iac-drift <project-template.json> <export-template.json>
       c2c schema-corpus <dir> [--label name] [--out file]
       c2c seed <file|dir> --out <dir> [--n 50] [--seed link] [--json] (exit 0 clean, 1 a form is blocked, 2 usage)
       c2c seed <file|dir> --creator-import --out <dir> [--rows 20] [--seed link]
              (when some tables are blocked, seed.json and the CSVs for unblocked tables are still written; blocked tables get no CSV, junction rows or fixture files)
       c2c migrate-data --dry-run --dc <dc> --creator-base <url> --catalyst-base <url> --owner <name> --app <link> --report <Report:Table> --checkpoint <file>
       c2c migrate-data --seed <file> --ds <file|dir> [--app <link>] [--project <id-or-name>] [--org <id>] [--confirm] [--checkpoint <file>] [--login-user <email>]
       c2c migrate-data --source-json <dir> --ds <file|dir> [--project <id-or-name>] [--org <id>] [--app <link>] [--confirm] [--allow-empty] [--checkpoint <file>]
       c2c migrate-data --source-csv <dir> --ds <file|dir> [--project <id-or-name>] [--org <id>] [--app <link>] [--confirm] [--allow-empty] [--checkpoint <file>]
       c2c migrate-data --source-backup <zip|dir> --ds <file|dir> [--project <id-or-name>] [--org <id>] [--app <link>] [--confirm] [--allow-empty] [--checkpoint <file>]
       c2c users plan --source-backup <zip|dir> --ds <file|dir> [--out <dir>] [--state <file>] [--salt <s>] [--social <a,b>] [--json]
       c2c users invite --source-backup <zip|dir> --ds <file|dir> --project <id> --org <org> --confirm [--slate-domain <host>] [--role-ids <name=id,...>] [--state <file>]
       c2c users list|add|disable|enable|set-role --ds <file|dir> --project <id> --org <org> [--email <e>] [--role <name>] [--user-id <id>] [--confirm]
       c2c sync-delta --source-json <dir> --ds <file|dir> --since <state-file|dir> [--project <id>] [--org <org>] [--confirm] [--apply-deletes] [--allow-mass-delete] [--max-delete-percent <pct>] [--prefer creator|catalyst|<Table>=creator|catalyst] [--conflicts <file>]
              (--source-csv <dir> and --source-backup <zip|dir> read the same reports)
       c2c cutover-checklist <file|dir> [--source-json|--source-csv <dir>|--source-backup <zip|dir>] [--since <state-file|dir>] [--smoke <file>] [--rollback-export <dir|file>] [--project <id>] [--dc <dc>] [--config <c2c-deploy.json>] [--out <dir>]
       c2c proof <file|dir> [same options as cutover-checklist]
       c2c rollback-export --ds <file|dir> --out <dir> --rows <dir> [--changed-since <state-file|dir>]
       c2c rollback-export --ds <file|dir> --out <dir> [--project <id-or-name>] [--org <id>] [--app <link>] [--confirm] [--changed-since <state-file|dir>] [--dc <dc>] [--config <c2c-deploy.json>]
              (without --rows: plans the tables to read; --confirm reads the rows from the project)
       c2c verify --data-parity --ds <file|dir> (--source-json <dir> | --source-csv <dir> | --source-backup <zip|dir>) --rows <dir> [--json]
       c2c verify-behavior <file|dir> --goldens <dir> [--report <file.json>] [--report-md <file.md>]
       c2c verify-behavior <file|dir> --goldens <dir> --live --confirm --url <fn-base> [--project <id>] [--org <id>] [--auth-token <token> | --session-cookie <name=value>]
       c2c deploy <file|dir> [--project <id-or-name>] [--org <id>] [--env Development] [--out <dir>] [--ui vanilla|react] [--mail [--mail-from <address> --mail-sender-verified]] [--confirm] [--resume] [--api-base <url>] [--function-env <file>|new] [--slate-domain <host>] [--slate-name <name>] [--admin-email <mail> --admin-name <name> --admin-role <name> --admin-role-id <id>] [--async-on-success [--triggers-wired]] [--subset-shims] [--source-backup <zip|dir>|--source-csv <dir>|--source-json <dir>] [--projects <file>] [--dc <dc>] [--config <c2c-deploy.json>] [--edits <file>] [--previous <deployed.ds> [--rename Form.Old=New]...]
              (--previous refuses a rename, drop or alter today and changes nothing: those are plan-only; --allow-destructive and --backup are plan flags)
       c2c deploy <file|dir> --backfill-shadows [--confirm] [--catalyst-base <url>] [--projects <file>] [--dc <dc>] [--config <c2c-deploy.json>]
       c2c plan <file|dir> --out <dir> [--dc <dc>] [--mail] [--project <id>] [--production] [--allow-budget-fail] [--previous <deployed.ds> [--rename Form.Old=New]... [--allow-destructive --backup <rollback-export dir>]]
              (--previous writes schema-change/delta.md and refuses a rename, drop or alter unless --allow-destructive names a verified --backup)
       c2c provision --out <dir> [--status|--next|--confirm --run <id>|--record <id> [--result <file>] [--applied]]
       c2c edit <file|dir> <op> ... [--dc <dc>] [--edits <file>] [--out <dir>] [--json] [--apply] [--confirm]
       c2c smoke <file|dir> [--project <id-or-name>] [--org <id>] [--url <app-url>] [--confirm] [--report <file>]
       c2c smoke <file|dir> --result-code <code|-> [--project <id>] [--url <app-url>] [--max-age <minutes>] [--report <file>]
       c2c smoke <file|dir> --result <file|-> [--project <id>] [--url <app-url>] [--max-age <minutes>] [--report <file>]
       c2c analyze <file|dir> [--json] [--lock <file>] [--quality]
       c2c precheck <file.ds> [--json]
       c2c doctor [--app <file.ds|dir>] [--dc <dc>] [--org <id>] [--project <id>] [--json] [--local] [--quiet]
       c2c doctor --mcp-begin [--json]
       c2c doctor --mcp-observed - [--dc <dc>] [--org <id>] [--project <id>]
       c2c --verify-vendor <dir>
       c2c migration-report <dir> [--label name] [--out file] [--json]
       c2c deluge <dir> [--label name] [--out file] [--top n]
       c2c ui <file|dir> --out <dir>
       c2c score-ui <file|dir> [--ui <dir>] [--json] [--write <score.json>]
       c2c ui-react <file|dir> --out <dir> [--api-base <url>] [--no-auth] [--upgrade-platform] [--force]
       c2c auth <file|dir> [--json|--apply] [--out file]
       c2c ui-corpus <dir> [--label name] [--out file]
       c2c fill-todos <file|dir> --emit <dir>
       c2c fill-todos <file|dir> --accept <task-id> <fill-file> [--lock c2c.lock.json]
       c2c fill-todos <file|dir> --lock <file> --report
       c2c status --project <id> [--org <id>] [--app <name>] [--json] [--fake] [--table-budget <n>]
